title: [Master]- Dispute Status – Inconsistent On Hold and Document Synchronization on Vendor Ledger Entries.
summary: Adds missing dispute status code for on hold and document synchronization to the Cust. Ledger Entry table in W1, completing a fix already merged in PR #13228. The country layer copies of the table each remove one line.
key_points: Adds the missing dispute status handling to the W1 Cust. Ledger Entry table
Follow-up to the already merged PR #13228 for the same issue
Removes one line from the Cust. Ledger Entry table in ten country layers (APAC, CH, ES, FI, FR, IS, IT, NA, NL, RU)
